scripts.title: Inventory and Shop Unlocker
scripts.script:
--[[
	WARNING: Heads up! This script has not been verified by ScriptBlox. Use at your own risk!
]]
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local shopGui = playerGui:WaitForChild("ShopGui")

-- Ensure ShopGui exists before proceeding
if not shopGui then
    warn("ShopGui not found in PlayerGui!")
    return
end

-- Get Inventory Skins Folder
local inventory = shopGui:FindFirstChild("Inventory")
local inventorySkins = inventory and inventory:FindFirstChild("Skins")
local inventoryFolder = inventorySkins and inventorySkins:FindFirstChild("Folder")

-- Get Shop Skins Folder
local shop = shopGui:FindFirstChild("Shop")
local shopSkins = shop and shop:FindFirstChild("Skins")
local shopFolder = shopSkins and shopSkins:FindFirstChild("Folder")

-- Function to make all ImageButtons visible inside a folder
local function makeImageButtonsVisible(folder)
    if folder then
        for _, item in pairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
            if item:IsA("ImageButton") then
                item.Visible = true
            end
        end
    else
        warn("Folder not found!")
    end
end

-- Make ImageButtons visible in both folders
makeImageButtonsVisible(inventoryFolder)
makeImageButtonsVisible(shopFolder)

-- Change the "Tokens" IntValue inside the player to "9999999"
local tokensValue = player:FindFirstChild("Tokens")
if tokensValue and tokensValue:IsA("IntValue") then
    tokensValue.Value = "9999999"
else
    warn("Tokens IntValue not found in player!")
end
